description: Compute exact daily p50 and p95 latency per API endpoint for the content platform. Include only requests with status_code < 500 and a non-NULL latency_ms. Percentiles must use linear interpolation (PERCENTILE_CONT semantics), not approximate quantiles. Output one row per endpoint per UTC day. Output columns: request_date (DATE), endpoint_path (STRING), request_count (INT64), p50_ms (FLOAT64), p95_ms (FLOAT64).

latency_ms.description: Response latency; NULL when the request timed out

edge_cases: 5xx responses are excluded even if their latency is recorded
NULL latency rows are excluded from both the count and the percentiles
Endpoint-day with a single request has p50 = p95 = that latency
common_failure_modes: FM4: PERCENTILE_CONT is an analytic-only function in BigQuery; using it with GROUP BY fails, and using it with OVER without DISTINCT returns one row per request
FM4: APPROX_QUANTILES returns approximate, non-interpolated values (p50 = 200 or 300 instead of 250)
FM3: Filtering status in the percentile but not in request_count makes the two metrics inconsistent
